note: 배치 3 — 자원 노드·바이옴 나무·식생 소품 22장. 노드 이름은 world.json nodes.types.name 정본. 캔버스는 §8 규격(나무 128x192 · 노드 96x96 · 소품 64x64, 그루터기만 96x96)을 따른다.

assets.name: 숲 노드
assets.desc: three overlapping broadleaf trees growing as one dense clump, shared canopy, lush green foliage in summer greens, straight trunks of different thickness rising from one shared root mass and merging into a single connected leaf mass, no autumn colors, no red or orange or silver leaves, trunk bases flush with the bottom edge

assets.name: 딸기 들
assets.desc: one single low round berry bush, one connected dome of dense small oval leaves with gaps showing the thin woody stems inside, bunches of ripe red berries hanging near the outer leaf tips, two fallen berries and a few dry twigs on the ground, one bush only, not several bushes, base flush with the bottom edge, growing directly from the ground, planted in soil, no pot, no planter, no container, no vase, not in a bowl

assets.name: 철광맥
assets.desc: a single large boulder with exposed rusty iron ore veins, one solid mass of gray faceted stone with chipped edges and small cracks, rust-brown and deep red metallic veins threading across the broken faces, a few pebbles at the base, sturdy and weighty, an inanimate rock object only, no people, base flush with the bottom edge

assets.name: 석탄 노두
assets.desc: a single large boulder with an exposed coal seam, one solid mass of gray faceted stone broken open to show a thick glossy black band with sharp shell-like fracture faces, coal dust darkening the stone below, a few chips at the base, an inanimate rock object only, no people, base flush with the bottom edge

assets.name: 유막
assets.desc: a single dark tar pool bubbling between cracked rocks, one shallow rocky basin holding glossy black liquid with amber and violet sheen highlights on its surface, the surrounding soil stained black and wet, two or three low stone lips framing the pool as one connected object, no creatures, no people, an inanimate ground object only, base flush with the bottom edge

assets.name: 고대 유적
assets.desc: the remains of an old stone structure gathered as one single cluster, two toppled cut blocks and a broken pillar drum in pale gray granite leaning against each other as one connected pile, weathered chipped corners with moss in the seams, one object group only, not a row of separate blocks, base flush with the bottom edge

assets.name: 숨은 궤
assets.desc: one single half-buried wooden crate under a canvas tarp, packed as one compact mound, two lumpy sacks resting on the crate lid and lashed down with rope so the whole thing reads as a single connected bundle, loose soil banked around the base hiding the lower half, one object only, not a row of crates, base flush with the bottom edge

assets.name: 야생 밭
assets.desc: one square patch of tilled dark soil with a few young sprouts growing in rows, seen as one plot, three or four low parallel earth ridges filling one small connected ground tile, thin green shoots and a few wild grass tufts rising from the ridges, one continuous patch of ground, not separate pots or planters, a low flat ground object seen from a top-down three-quarter view

assets.name: 설산 침엽수
assets.desc: a tall conifer laden with snow, a straight dark trunk with plated bark under a narrow conical crown of tiered needle branches, thick snow caps resting on every tier with dark needle tips showing through at the edges, a small drift and two fallen cones at the roots, trunk base flush with the bottom edge

assets.name: 밀림 활엽수
assets.desc: a broad tropical hardwood, a smooth pale trunk flaring into buttress fins at the ground, a wide flat canopy built from large deep green leaf clusters in overlapping tiers, hanging vines dropping from two lower limbs and one bromeliad clump wedged in a fork, ferns crowding the roots, trunk base flush with the bottom edge

assets.name: 사막 선인장
assets.desc: a tall columnar desert cactus, a thick ribbed green trunk with two upraised arms of unequal height, evenly spaced spine clusters marching along every rib, one small waxy cream flower crowning the top, dry sand and a scatter of pebbles banked at the base, base flush with the bottom edge

assets.name: 화산재 고사목
assets.desc: a dead tree standing in volcanic ash, a bare charred trunk with peeling black bark and broken branch stubs reaching upward, gray ash dust settled into the bark crevices and coating the upper limbs, scorched cracked ground and fallen splinters at the base, trunk base flush with the bottom edge

assets.name: 거대 버섯
assets.desc: a mushroom grown to the size of a tree, a thick fibrous cream stalk with a ring skirt beneath a wide domed cap, the cap deep violet with pale raised warts on top and dense radiating gills underneath, a second smaller cap leaning against the stalk, moss and spore dust at the base, stalk base flush with the bottom edge

assets.name: 습지 버드나무
assets.desc: a willow leaning out over marsh water, a twisted gray trunk with deep bark furrows and knuckled roots breaking the mud, long drooping branches hung with narrow silver-green leaf strands, a tuft of hanging moss and one snapped limb, root base flush with the bottom edge

assets.name: 황혼 나무
assets.desc: one single slender twilight valley tree with one trunk, smooth dark bark banded with a few pale rings, one airy crown of small violet and dusty blue leaf clusters riding fine upswept branches, a scatter of faintly luminous pale petals near the branch tips, fallen violet leaves ringing the roots, one tree only, not a row of trees, not multiple drawings, trunk base flush with the bottom edge

assets.name: 갈대
assets.desc: one single clump of marsh reeds growing from one wet muddy spot, tall narrow blades fanning upward together from the same base, two brown seed spikes standing above the rest, one blade bent halfway down, one connected tuft only, not several separate plants, not a set of variations, base flush with the bottom edge

assets.name: 작은 덤불
assets.desc: one single small round shrub, one compact dome of rounded leaf clusters with gaps showing the dark inner twigs, two bare lower branches poking out at the side, a thin litter of fallen leaves at the foot, one bush only, not several bushes, not a set of variations, base flush with the bottom edge

assets.name: 들꽃
assets.desc: one single tuft of wildflowers growing from one spot of soil, small white and yellow blooms with two violet ones on slender stems rising together from the same leaf tuft, a pair of unopened buds leaning outward, one connected clump only, not scattered separate flowers, not a set of variations, base flush with the bottom edge

assets.name: 자갈
assets.desc: one single cluster of loose stones heaped together, six rounded gray pebbles of differing size packed into one small connected pile with one flat flake resting across the top, a scatter of grit around the base, one compact group only, not a spread-out row, base flush with the bottom edge

assets.name: 그루터기
assets.desc: a freshly cut tree stump, a broad pale sawn top showing concentric growth rings and one radial split, rough dark bark wrapping the sides, root flares spreading out into the ground, a few wood chips and a curled bark strip lying beside it, base flush with the bottom edge

assets.name: 보리
assets.desc: one single mature barley plant ready for harvest, one upright bundle of golden stalks growing from the same root, heavy bearded seed heads bowing at the tips, narrow dry leaves sheathing the stems, a small ridge of tilled soil at the foot, one plant only, not a row of plants, base flush with the bottom edge

assets.name: 채소밭 작물
assets.desc: one single full grown vegetable plant, one rosette of broad crinkled green leaves with pale ribs opening from a short stalk, one round root shoulder pushing up out of the tilled soil, two nibbled holes in the outer leaves, one plant only, not a row of plants, not a set of variations, base flush with the bottom edge
